messages:
emma (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the discovery /capabilities shape this sprint. customers keep asking for a machine-readable surface: streaming support, tool list, token limits, and structured-output schema.

mike (eng): +1. rough proposal for payload shape:```json
{
  "supports_streaming": true,
  "max_input_tokens": 8192,
  "max_output_tokens": 4096,
  "tools": [ { "name": "search", "id": "search.v1", "invocation_schema": "url/to/schema", "requires_auth": false, "sync": true } ],
  "structured_output": { "schema_url": "https://docs/.../schema.json", "strict_validation": false },
  "token_window": { "request_window": 16384, "soft_limit": 0.95 }
}
```this covers most asks but we should keep fields optional for older models.

leila (product): important launch gating: docs + SDK defaulting, sample prompts showing streaming vs polling, and explicit guidance on how to fall back when tools not supported. also need to communicate billing implications for large max_output_tokens.

ana (customer success): bump from two enterprise pilots — they need a field that signals if tool calls could access customer data (e.g., "data_access": "none|read|write") so they can evaluate compliance.

mike (eng): good call. add minimal "data_access" enum per-tool. also suggest adding "compat_versions": ["1.0"] to support future contract changes.

opsec-bot: note — any metadata exposing internal model ids must be allowlisted for external customers. reach out to security for hull policy.

emma (PM): agreed. we should keep the surface limited to: streaming boolean, token caps (input/output/window), tools array (name,id,invocation_schema,sync,requires_auth,data_access), structured_output schema_url + validation mode, compat_versions. keep extra telemetry hooks optional.

sanjay (infra): rollout constraints: discovery calls will be frequent from SDKs at app startup. recommend a 5s cache TTL + ETag support at the endpoint; rate-limit to 60/min per API key. canary flow: start with Dedicated tenants -> internal hosts -> hosted 5% -> 20% -> full.

leila (product): can we add requirement: the endpoint must return stable ids for tools for 90 days to avoid client churn? enterprise customers asked for this.

mike (eng): yes — add "stability_window_days": 90 for tool ids. implementation note: we may need a background job to maintain id aliases during rollouts.

emma (PM): launch criteria checklist (initial draft):
- spec doc merged + example payloads
- SDKs (py/js) read capabilities and expose helpers
- docs + migration guide for clients
- canary + cache/ETag behavior validated (infra)
- compliance flags present (data_access)
- telemetry: hits, cache miss rate, deprecated flag usage
- perf: response < 50ms p95 under 500 RPS after caching

ana (customer success): phasing note: tell pilots we'll expose a non-breaking query param to opt-in to extended token info (detailed token_window) while default stays conservative.

opsec-bot: security checklist: ensure schemas are served over HTTPS, schema URLs are only pointers (no executable code), and auth checks for per-tool requires_auth flags are enforced.

mike (eng): dev plan: PR for schema + lightweight service returning demo payload by EOD Fri; follow-up to wire TTL caching and ETag next week.

emma (PM): prioritization: MVP to include: streaming flag, max_input/output, tools with basic metadata + data_access, structured_output schema_url, compat_versions, stability_window_days, cache headers. Advanced: token_window detailed breakdown, per-route recommendations, and model-specific fallback mapping.

leila (product): customer-driven asks we should track as post-MVP: explicit token cost estimation, per-tool latency SLOs, and a signed manifest for enterprise audit.

emma (PM): action items:
- mike: push schema PR and a sample server (due Fri)
- sanjay: draft cache/rate-limit config + canary plan
- leila: update product brief and add to release notes
- ana: notify the two pilot customers about opt-in extended info

mike (eng): noted. will create branch refs in the PR and tag infra for canary config.

emma (PM): thanks — will schedule 30m follow-up Wed to review the schema before we merge. :thumbsup:
